facts.text: NJIT was established on February 9, 1881, as the Newark Technical School and opened with 88 students.
facts.sourceNote: Wikipedia: New Jersey Institute of Technology

facts.text: Campbell Hall on the NJIT campus was erected in 1925.
Eberhardt Hall, built in 1857 as the Newark Orphan Asylum, is the oldest building on the NJIT campus.
Cullimore Hall was built in 1958 and Weston Hall was rebuilt as a seven-story building two years later.
The Central King Building was dedicated in 1912 and bought by NJIT in 2010.
